decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork. The firm is expanding and has slack, so it can carry the product while results are still uncertain, and nothing here signals a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy recovery. With growing turnover and slack, management would keep it despite modest web visibility rather than reallocate its resources.
The overflow flap gate has a dedicated page and lies close to the established offer, which suggests results meet aspirations. Dropping it would bring little benefit.
